node: Nuclear fuel, HALEU, reactor components, and nuclear EPC execution
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the nuclear-fuel/components/EPC chokepoint found a two-lane universe: reference names with already visible nuclear scarcity exposure, and underfollowed/speculative suppliers one or two steps away from headline reactor developers. The highest-evidence scarcity exposures are Centrus Energy for U.S. HALEU/enrichment and BWX Technologies for nuclear fuel/components and defense enrichment infrastructure. The underfollowed discovery lane is Mirion Technologies, a radiation-monitoring/instrumentation provider embedded in nuclear safety, compliance, SMR, and reactor-lifecycle workflows. ASP Isotopes is included only as a speculative shadow candidate because it has announced HALEU-related TerraPower agreements, but commercial uranium-enrichment capability, financing, licensing, and scale-up require verification.
